title: Local homotopy normal form at a good residue point
statement: Let $Y,Y'$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $P$ be a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-derived-category] whose terms are finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and let $d,i,r\in\mathbb N$. Assume $P^n=0$ for $n<0$ and $n>d$. Let $g:Y'\to Y$ be a morphism and $z\in Y'$. Suppose the termwise residue pullback $P_{g(z)}$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] has zero cohomology in all nonnegative degrees other than $i$ and finite locally free degree-$i$ cohomology of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Then there is an open neighbourhood $U\subseteq Y'$ of $z$ and a homotopy equivalence of cochain complexes between $(g^*P)|_U$ and the single complex on $\mathcal O_U^r$ in degree $i$. A homotopy equivalence consists of chain maps in both directions whose composites are chain homotopic to the identity.

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-finite-free-residue-stalk-homotopy at y = g(z) to obtain a homotopy equivalence over Spec(O_{Y,y}) with the pullback of the single free rank-r complex in degree i.
Apply lem-pc-finite-free-stalk-homotopy-spread to obtain an open neighbourhood V of g(z) and a homotopy equivalence between the restrictions of P and that single complex.

Take U = g^{-1}(V); its membership condition is z in U because g(z) lies in V. Pull back the equivalence along g restricted to V. The natural isomorphisms identifying restriction with pullback, pullback of a composition, and pullback along equal morphisms identify the source with (g^*P)|_U. The single-complex comparison and restriction/pullback of a free sheaf identify the target with the single rank-r free complex on U. Compose the induced homotopy equivalences of these isomorphisms with the pulled-back equivalence. This is the complete Lean proof.

proof_origin.place: Proof, first two paragraphs and forward base-change direction; local-ring and spreading steps split into separate statements, with base change proved using Mathlib natural isomorphisms.
